question: UPI is a system that powers multiple bank accounts into a single mobile application. What is the full form of UPI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unified Payments Interface**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unified Payments Interface**

 
 
• Unified Payments Interface (UPI) is a system that powers multiple bank accounts into a single mobile application (of any participating bank), merging several banking features, seamless fund routing & merchant payments into one hood.
 
• It also caters to the “Peer to Peer” collect request which can be scheduled and paid as per requirement and convenience.
 
• NPCI conducted a pilot launch on 11th April 2016 by Dr Raghuram G Rajan, Governor, RBI at Mumbai.
 
• Banks have started to upload their UPI-enabled Apps on the Google Play store from 25th August 2016 onwards.
 
 
 
• **Participants in UPI**
 
 
• Payer PSP (Payment service Provider)
 
• Payee PSP
 
• Remitter Bank
 
• Beneficiary Bank
 
• NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India)
 
• Bank Account holders
 
• Merchant
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mobile Banking**

 
 
• It refers to the use of a mobile device to carry out financial transactions anywhere.
 
• ​This service is provided by majorly all financial institutions, especially banks.
 
• Mobile banking enables customers to carry out various transactions, which may vary depending on the institutions.
 
• Mobile banking services can be categorized into, account information, transaction, investment, support service, content, and news.
 
• It can be done either through the internet or by SMS.
 
• In 2002 mobile banking was started in India by a way through SMS
